jobs.title: Product Manager, Google Pay
jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership.
* 2 years of experience in software development or engineering.
* 2 years of experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
* 1 year of experience in technical leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


Google Pay is one of the leading UPI apps in India. Our mission is to make payments and commerce simple, fast, and reliable to unlock a brighter financial future for everyone in India. We aim to provide affordable access to financial services across the region. Specifically, Google Pay aims to empower all users with the confidence to participate in the digital economy by making it the simplest, safest, and most trusted financial platform. The overall goal is to reduce transaction friction and enhance everyday financial experiences.


Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work with partner teams (e.g., engineers, PgMs, UX) during product design and development to implement the requirements to turn PRDs into OKRs for one or more teams.
* Define product roadmaps by operationalizing strategy.
* Develop and secure buy\-in for a product goal that identifies, defines, and supports the overall product narrative and direction, achieving an outcome that is greater than the sum of its parts.
* Validate the market size and opportunity (e.g., user\-based, strategic opportunity, business generation).
* Drive launches, maintenance, and retirement in collaboration with other cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.

jobs.title: Data Management Lead - Agentic AI for Data
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Make your mark by using Agentic AI to shape how teams build trusted and AI\-ready data at scale as they go through the Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC). Join the Firmwide Chief Data Office at JPMorganChase where your work directly improves speed, quality, and governance in data delivery. Bring your product mindset and technical fluency to help design a platform that grows your career through high\-impact, enterprise\-wide collaboration.

**Job Summary**


As an Agentic AI Lead for the DDLC at JPMorganChase, you will help build and scale an agentic artificial intelligence solution that enables Data Product Managers to execute the end\-to\-end Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC) – from ideation and modeling through publishing, governance, and consumption. You will translate business needs into a clear technical roadmap, validate engineering delivery, and improve how teams publish and consume governed data products. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to define success measures, evaluate capability releases, and drive adoption across multiple business areas.


This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, data product delivery, and software engineering execution. Your knowledge of agentic best practices will help build out the architecture for this solution including skills, tools and the harness. Your knowledge of data engineering/science best practices will help translate business needs into technical solutions. You will run structured discovery with business stakeholders to understand current workflows and friction points, then convert those insights into prioritized requirements and measurable outcomes. You will also support executive communications by synthesizing progress into concise narratives, metrics, and roadmap updates.

* Design and run structured user\-feedback loops (interviews, shadowing sessions, usability tests, telemetry review) to continuously refine tool capabilities against real DPM workflows.
* Partner with engineering leads to convert business needs into well\-scoped technical requirements and discrete, assignable tasks for data engineers and AI engineers.
* Validate delivered capabilities by reviewing agent behaviors, generated outputs, and integrated workflows to ensure they match intent and agreed standards.
* Define and track acceptance criteria, success metrics, and evaluation frameworks (e.g., agent task\-completion rate, output quality, human\-in\-the\-loop intervention rate) for each capability release.Coordinate delivery execution through backlog refinement, sprint planning support, release readiness checks, and dependency management across teams.
* Contribute to the multi\-year roadmap for scaling the agentic tool from PoC to a firmwide platform – including capability expansion, LOB onboarding sequencing, and platform hardening.
* Develop a working point of view on the target agentic architecture: orchestration patterns, scheduling, agent\-to\-agent communication, memory/state management, tool registries, and evaluation infrastructure.
* Identify reusable components, shared services, and integration points with existing firmwide data platforms and skills repositories.
* Partner with governance, risk, controls, legal, and compliance stakeholders to ensure responsible use and appropriate controls are embedded into the solution. Collaborate and align with data engineers, data scientists, product managers, architects, and technology partners to achieve business outcomes.
* Drive coordination and communication with senior stakeholders to advance the DDLC strategy and secure ongoing sponsorship. Produce executive\-ready materials: roadmap updates, PoC readouts, adoption metrics, and business\-value narratives.




**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Demonstrated understanding of agentic artificial intelligence patterns, including single\-agent, multi\-agent, and orchestrated approaches.
* Working knowledge of generative artificial intelligence building blocks, including large language models, prompt design, retrieval augmented generation, context design, evaluation methods, and safety controls.
* Hands\-on experience using modern generative artificial intelligence development tools (for example, enterprise\-approved coding assistants or agent\-enabled integrated development environments).
* Working knowledge of data engineering concepts, including deployment pipelines, continuous integration and continuous delivery, environment promotion, testing strategies, and observability.
* Working knowledge of the data development lifecycle, including data modeling, schema and contract design, metadata management, data quality, lineage, and publishing standards.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical work items, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience running pilots in a large, regulated enterprise environment, including stakeholder alignment and release discipline.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to connect senior stakeholder priorities to engineering execution.
* Track record of end\-to\-end delivery in data, data science, or data product work in consulting or internal consulting contexts.

UI/UX Technical Architect
Hyderabad, Telangana
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Technical Architect for UI/UX Designs is responsible for overseeing the technical aspects of UI/UX design projects. They will collaborate with internal teams and clients to ensure the successful delivery of visually appealing and user\-friendly interfaces. The primary objective is to architect solutions that optimize user experience and align with business goals.

------------------------


1\. Lead the technical design and implementation of ui/ux projects from conception to delivery.

3\. Conduct technical reviews, identify design gaps, and recommend solutions to enhance user experience.
  

4\. Develop prototypes and wireframes to validate design concepts and functional requirements.
  

5\. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to suggest innovative solutions for ui/ux challenges.
  

6\. Provide guidance on frontend technologies, frameworks, and tools to ensure efficient implementation of designs.
  

7\. Support in the evaluation and selection of design tools and software to streamline the design process.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Proficiency in ui/ux design principles and best practices.
  

2\. Strong knowledge of frontend development technologies such as html, css, javascript.
  

3\. Experience with design tools like adobe xd, sketch, figma, or similar.
  

4\. Ability to understand user needs and translate them into engaging design concepts.
  

5\. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross functional teams.
  

6\. Problem\-solving skills to identify design issues and propose effective solutions.
  

7\. Familiarity with agile methodologies and project management tools.
**Other Requirements**

1\.UX Design Certification or relevant industry certifications are a plus.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.


We are evolving our product portfolio across all digital capabilities. As that portfolio grows, we need a Technical Product Manager who can connect business needs to technical delivery, ensuring the products we build are not only strategically aligned, but also practical, measurable, and well\-adopted.


We are looking for a Technical Product Manager who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and engineering teams. The Technical Product Manager will translate business, operational, and technical requirements into clear product priorities, release plans, and acceptance criteria and will drive the adoption and continuous improvement of the products we deliver.

**What you will do?**


You will work closely with Engineering Managers, Solution Architects, UX/UI Designers, QA, DevOps, business stakeholders, and leadership to shape the product direction and ensure delivery stays aligned to business outcomes.


In practice, that means you will turn strategic intent into a clear product roadmap, define well\-scoped backlog items, and help the team build products that are useful, usable, and measurable.

**Define and prioritise product direction**

* Define and communicate the product vision aligned with business objectives.
* Maintain the product roadmap based on customer needs, market trends, and strategic priorities.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Evaluate market trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies to guide product direction.
 **Translate needs into delivery\-ready plans**

* Gather and analyse business requirements from customers and stakeholders.
* Translate business needs into clear features, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Define product goals, success metrics, and release objectives.
* Prioritise the backlog using business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility.
* Balance short\-term delivery with long\-term product strategy.
 **Own delivery and adoption**

* Own and manage the product backlog.
* Work closely with cross functional delivery teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Product owners, Delivery leads, Engineering Managers and Solution Architects to plan releases.
* Support user acceptance testing, production readiness, and post\-release adoption.
**Product analytics**

* Define and monitor key performance indicators.
* Analyse product performance using customer feedback, usage metrics, and business data.
* Make data\-driven decisions for future enhancements.
* Track feature adoption, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.
**Collaborate across functions**

* Build strong relationships with customers, business leaders, and cross\-functional teams.
* Gather feedback through interviews, workshops, and product usage insights.
* Communicate product vision, roadmap, and release plans to stakeholders.
* Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, UX/UI, QA, DevOps, Cloud Infra, Marketing product teams, mobile app teams, program managers, business, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership.
* Ensure alignment across teams throughout the product lifecycle.
 **What you bring?**

**Experience and Preferred Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, or Product Owner.
* Experience with customer\-facing mobile applications is preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of experience managing digital or software products.
* Experience working with Agile software development teams.
* Experience engaging multiple stakeholders, facilitating requirements sessions, and turning ambiguity into clear priorities.
* Experience working in a medical device, hearing aid, or regulated healthcare product environment.
* Professional certifications such as CSPO, PSPO, SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner, or Pragmatic Institute certifications.
 **Technical skills**

* Product roadmap planning and product lifecycle management
* Release planning, product discovery, and requirements management
* Microsoft Azure fundamentals
* Working knowledge of AI\-assisted product discovery and documentation tools
 **Personal competencies**

* You are a natural connector, you build trust with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and keep them aligned.
* You are precise with definitions. You know that unclear requirements create avoidable product risk.
* You are thorough in documentation. You treat roadmaps, specifications, and acceptance criteria as deliverables.
* You advocate for the customer and the business, you think about how the product will be used and how it creates value.

 Our platform solutions are sector\-agnostic, and our network of corporate customers covers the BFSI, Technology, Healthcare, Manufacturing, FMCG, Infrastructure and Automobile industries, among others. Some of our well\-known customers include TATA Steel, Persistent Systems, Toshiba, Inox, Pitney Bowes, Wockhardt, PCBL (RP –Sanjiv Goenka Group) and Greenply Industries to name a few. Visit us at www.zaggle.in to know more about us!
 



  





 We believe “Innovation is the Key” and Zaggle has been instrumental with launching multiple successful products in the last 3 years in the Business Spend Management space. Today we are a 300\+ member strong team spread across Technology, Product, Sales, Implementation Services, Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal and Support functions with 7 office locations in India.
 



  





**About the job** 




 Own the client\-driven P2P roadmap for requests that affect implementation, renewals and existing accounts. Prioritise client requirements, work with engineering to deliver them, and confirm that each release solves the issue raised.
 



 This hands\-on product role works closely with implementation, customer success, support and engineering on an enterprise SaaS platform with contractual timelines.
 



  





**Responsibilities :** 




**Client requests and delivery** 



* Intake, triage and prioritisation of all requests from implementation, onboarding and existing clients.
* The backlog of existing\-client feature requests and enhancement asks — kept current, sized and defensible.
* A working partnership with customer success and support on the pain points blocking renewals or expansion.
* Acceptance criteria for client\-specific and client\-driven requirements, written so QA and engineering can act on them without a follow\-up meeting.
* Scoping and delivery timelines agreed with engineering, and the communication of those timelines to everyone waiting on them.
* SLA tracking for client and implementation commitments, including contract\-tied deadlines.
* Sprint delivery for client requests you own sprint completion rate and the scrum cadence for this track.
* Live issues, bug fixes and the technical debt that surfaces through client interactions.
* Status and timeline communication back to CS, implementation and support, without them having to chase you.
* Escalation of repeated requests upward as candidate roadmap items for the growth track.



**How success is measured** 



* Sprint completion rate on client requests; resolution time and SLA adherence
* Fewer implementation blockers; CSAT and NPS tied to responsiveness
* Churn risk mitigated through resolution of specific product gaps



**To succeed in the role** 




**Qualifications and experience** 



* This one is non\-negotiable: you must come from a P2P product background. The product you own today or owned most recently has to be a procure\-to\-pay product. We are not able to consider strong PMs from adjacent SaaS categories for this role.
* Minimum 3 years in product management, owning a product or module rather than only gathering requirements for one.
* Deep, current knowledge of the P2P industry: who the buyers are, how procurement and finance teams actually work, who you compete with and where each of you is weak.
* You can walk us through your product end to end the workflow, the edge cases, the trade\-offs you chose and why without a deck.
* Experience with enterprise clients, contractual SLAs and requirements that arrive mid\-implementation.
* Comfortable running a sprint with engineering: writing stories, defining acceptance criteria, sizing with the team, holding the cadence.
* Clear written communication. Most of this job is making a decision legible to people who were not in the room.



**P2P skills and know\-how** 



* Intake to procure: catalogue and non\-catalogue requisitions, approval matrices, budget checks, purchase requests, and the politics of an approval chain.
* PO lifecycle: PO creation and amendments, blanket and service POs, partial receipts, GRN, closures.

An experienced operation manager for the SSGM India COO organization with a proven record of managing processes and large teams in the area of securities lending, mark to market, SBL, Corporate actions, Settlements of FI or Equity and Collateral management.

  

  

**Why this role is important to us**


The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSGM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world. Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.  

  



**What you will be responsible for**

As Agency Lending \- Collateral \& Settlements \-Assistant Vice President, you will

* Executes instructions to receive or deliver securities from counterparties.

* Communicates with other team members from diverse background in an effective manner. Influences and motivates the team. Creates an empowering climate. Projects an inspiring presence and collaborates by fostering a network of communication
* Demonstrates flexibility and effectiveness with changing environments, tasks, responsibilities \& people. Is open to change and new ideas while maintaining core goals and values. Adapts behavior and work methods in response to new information, changes or organization demands
* Ability of an individual to facilitate the continuous development of individual \& organizational competencies, developing other’s potential through the sharing of expertise and providing timely feedback. Continue to coach and mentor staff.
* Track and monitor the workflow queues/day to day workload/pending requests/mailbox to avoid any potential issues and delays and ensure 100% SLA and accuracy and timelines for BAU deliverables.
* Drive opportunities to work across groups in support of client needs, contribute in enhancing operating model and key Business Unit and Transformation initiatives, deliver on business and regulatory initiatives as per set timelines, achieve our financial commitments by providing better client service.
* Always finding better ways to improve the process\-you are responsible to drive and provide process improvement ideas to make the process and operating model better and efficient. Encourage staff to think differently. Look to provide time saves and risk reduction
* Ensure 3 tier back up and bolster resiliency by planning split ops across both locations.
* SSGM COO transformation \- understand and assess internal control environment to drive year\-over\-year improvement and enhancement of internal controls – promote self identification working in partnership with the global SSGM Business Controls teams

jobs.description:
Hi,

Hope you are doing well. My name is Chandrika, and I’m reaching out from Engineering Square — an IT consulting and outsourcing company that helps businesses find the right tech talent quickly.

Please take a look at the job description below. If it looks like a good fit for you, just reply with your updated resume and your expected salary.

Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)

Delivery leadership · Experience Cloud partner portals · Consumer lending on Salesforce · Salesforce ↔ NetSuite integration · Offshore

ABOUT ENGINEERING SQUARE

Engineering Square LLC is a Fremont, California–based enterprise consulting firm delivering Salesforce, integration, and AI engineering for US enterprise clients. Our engineers embed directly with client teams — their tools, their ceremonies — with E2 engagement management and a named backup behind every seat.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Lead the offshore pod supporting a US solar manufacturer and its consumer\-financing affiliate. This is a full\-time Engineering Square role placed with the client. You own the solution design within the client's architecture across two Salesforce orgs, run code review and release discipline, and act as the pod's day\-to\-day coordination point with the client's delivery leads — daily standups, work tracked on the client's boards, and a modern CI/CD pipeline. The strongest signal we are hiring for is a lead who has shipped an Experience Cloud partner portal end to end, has led delivery on Salesforce in a lending business, and has owned an ERP integration — and who still writes Apex and LWC on the hardest stories.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the design: own the solution design and integration architecture within the client's landscape across both orgs — cross\-org integration, shared partner data, and one\-way data hand\-offs built on custom objects alongside the managed lending package, never inside it

Lead the Experience Cloud portal work: partner and customer sites — self\-registration and onboarding, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing, federated login, LWC and page development; set the portal standards the developers build to

Lead the lending\-platform build: application intake, status visibility, document and e\-signature steps on the origination platform; design the post\-origination processes — funding, disbursement and servicing hand\-off — on custom objects alongside the managed package

Own the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration: the lead backlog item — customer/account, product and pricing sync; opportunity → sales order; invoice and payment status back\-sync; reconciliation of Salesforce, ERP and warehouse data. Own the design, the error handling, retries, idempotency and monitoring

Design partner APIs with monitoring: externally consumed APIs for installer and channel partners, with authentication, versioning, logging, alerting and replay built in from the first release

Run code review and release discipline: lead code reviews; hold the release checklist; enforce unit\-test coverage, PMD static analysis and Confluence design notes and runbooks; nothing ships without QA sign\-off

Mentor the pod: set the pod's engineering standard; mentor the senior developer and the developer; run the E2 round\-1 technical screen for new pod members

Be the coordination point with the client: join the client's daily standup inside the overlap window; report status, risks and the coming week's plan directly to client stakeholders — business, product and platform owners; send the Friday written summary; raise risks early, never late

CONTEXT YOU WILL WORK IN

Two Salesforce orgs. The manufacturer runs a Sales, Service and Experience Cloud org with an installer partner portal (self\-registration, knowledge, support). Its consumer\-financing affiliate runs a separate org on a Salesforce\-native loan and lease origination managed package, with its own installer partner portal (login federated to an external identity provider). Around both sit NetSuite (ERP — the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration is the lead backlog item), Snowflake (financing and credit\-risk analytics), an AWS integration layer (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS) and an integration platform. Work spans both orgs: cross\-org integration, shared partner data, one\-way data hand\-offs alongside the managed package.

MUST\-HAVE SKILLS

Experience Cloud — partner portals: has implemented at least one Experience Cloud partner portal end to end — site build (LWR or Aura), self\-registration and onboarding flow, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing. Candidates who have shipped a partner portal go to the top of the list

Lending domain: Salesforce in financial services or consumer lending — origination lifecycle, borrower and partner (dealer / installer) journeys

Loan\-origination package: hands\-on with a Salesforce\-native loan/lease origination managed package. Q2 Cloud Lending / Symphonix experience strongly preferred

Delivery leadership: has led a delivery team of engineers on at least one client\-facing Salesforce implementation — owned the solution design, ran code review and releases, and was accountable to the client for the outcome; has owned the integration on at least one ERP\-connected implementation

Salesforce core: Apex, LWC, Flows, SOQL, asynchronous Apex, Platform Events; Named Credentials; Salesforce CDC, Bulk and Streaming APIs; hands\-on on the hardest stories

APIs and integrations: REST, GraphQL and SOAP; API design — contracts, versioning, auth, error semantics; an integration platform of the Workato / MuleSoft / Boomi class; AWS Lambda, API Gateway and SQS

NetSuite integration (hands\-on): SuiteTalk (REST/SOAP) or RESTlets; quote\-to\-cash and order\-to\-cash object flows between Salesforce and NetSuite

jobs.title: Brightstar Hospitality - Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Talent Formula (http://talentformula.co) is a consulting firm that offers outsourced financial and accounting Human Resources to Chartered Accounting firms worldwide. We currently have a Data Analyst position available with our client, Brightstar Hospitality. This role offers a unique opportunity to be a team member based in India.**About Client**
Brightstar Hospitality is an award\-winning hotel management company operating a growing portfolio on behalf of a range of owners, supported by a central finance function based at our head office. Our motto is people – quality – profit, and it is no accident that people come first. As the group grows, so does the volume, variety and importance of our data, and we are investing in the systems, structure and expertise needed to turn that data into faster, better\-informed commercial decisions.**The Role**
This is a newly created role within central finance, with a group\-wide remit spanning finance, revenue management, operations, marketing and people. You will own how data moves through Brightstar, from how it is captured, ingested, validated and structured through to how it is analysed and reported, across three dimensions: data management and architecture; analysis and insight; and automation and AI, principally using Claude.
You will also support the Finance Director in the evaluation and implementation of a new FP\&A planning and consolidation platform (Datarails and comparable products are currently under evaluation). The role is not owner\-facing, but the colleagues who manage owner relationships will rely on your analysis and reporting. This is a hands\-on, build\-and\-own role, suiting someone with three to four years of practical data management and analysis experience who wants the scope, autonomy and senior\-level access to design something properly from the ground up. **Key Responsibilities****Data Management, Ingestion and Architecture*** Own the ingestion of data from hotel and central systems (PMS, RMS, POS, payroll, procurement and the finance ledgers) into a structured, reliable central reporting layer, replacing manual collection with automated data flows.
* Design and maintain the data architecture underpinning group reporting, including the multi\-hotel profit and loss database covering prior\-year actuals, budget, current\-year actuals and forecast at general ledger level, with standardised mapping and chart\-of\-accounts alignment across entities and properties.
* Establish and run data\-quality controls covering completeness, reconciliation to source, exception reporting and validation, and maintain clear documentation of data sources, definitions, transformations and lineage.

**Reporting, Insight and Commercial Analysis*** Produce and develop the group’s recurring management reporting, KPI dashboards and variance analysis for hotel, central, executive and board audiences, with clear commentary identifying trends, variances, risks and opportunities.
* Build and maintain self\-service dashboards, rationalise duplicated reporting, and establish a single version of the truth for each key measure.
* Analyse trading performance across the portfolio, including occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, segmentation, channel mix, length of stay and booking curve, and support rate, demand, competitor and market analysis for revenue meetings.
* Analyse distribution and channel economics including OTA cost of sale, and bring together commercial, operational, payroll and guest\-experience data to analyse profitability and productivity at property, department and segment level.

**Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting*** Build and maintain the models and driver frameworks used across the group for budgeting and forecasting, designed so that finance, operations and commercial colleagues can work in them directly.
* Develop and maintain the underlying assumption and driver logic for demand, rate, payroll, cost inflation and recharges, with centralised, transparent assumptions, and build scenario and sensitivity analysis to support decision\-making.
* Support the annual budget cycle and periodic reforecasting, and support the Finance Director on the new FP\&A platform, including data mapping, dimension and hierarchy design, integration, testing and user onboarding.

**AI, Automation and Data Governance*** Apply AI tooling, principally Claude, to accelerate and improve recurring analysis, reporting and data preparation, and build repeatable AI workflows such as structured projects, prompt libraries and documented instructions that produce consistent, auditable results.
* Configure and maintain the integrations that give AI tooling controlled access to our data, including the Microsoft 365 and SharePoint environment and the finance ledgers.
* Evaluate new tooling and techniques, run proportionate pilots, and act as the practical enabler for AI adoption, training colleagues and building internal capability rather than concentrating it in one person.
* Co\-own the group’s data and AI governance framework with the Finance Director, covering ownership, definitions, access, retention and change control, ensuring personal data is handled in line with UK GDPR, access is segregated appropriately between properties, entities and owners, and card and payment data is excluded from analytical environments in line with PCI DSS.

**Collaboration and Business Partnering*** Act as the central point of contact for data and analysis across finance, revenue management, operations, marketing and people, supporting colleagues who manage owner relationships and working with General Managers to improve data capture at source.
* Present findings clearly and confidently to audiences who are not data specialists, including at executive and board level, and challenge constructively when the data does not support the conclusion being drawn.

jobs.title: AI Knowledge Analyst I
jobs.description:
**Role Summary**



The AI Knowledge Analyst is a member of the Customer Care and Managed Services team, responsible for ensuring the knowledge ecosystems that power GHX's operations and AI platforms are accurate, well\-governed, and continuously improving. This role works closely with leadership, SMEs, data scientists, and operational teams to identify content gaps, manage knowledge lifecycles, and translate business needs into structured, AI\-ready information assets. The AI Knowledge Analyst is equally comfortable working through a detailed content audit and presenting a structured recommendation to leadership. Strong organizational skills, clear communication, and a bias for action are required. This is a role for someone who treats knowledge gaps as solvable problems and can move from gap identification to resolution with minimal direction.


**Core Focus Areas**


**Knowledge Governance \& Lifecycle Management**



Maintain, organize, and govern the knowledge assets that support Customer Care and Managed Services teams. This includes managing intake, triage, and routing of knowledge requests; driving SME review cycles; and ensuring content is accurate, current, and ready for both human use and AI ingestion.


**AI Knowledge Readiness**



Identify, structure, and groom content that feeds GHX's AI platform. Partner with AI and data teams to ensure knowledge assets are formatted, accurate, and optimized for ingestion. Monitor AI solution performance and drive content improvements that translate into measurable efficiency gains.


**Roles \& Responsibilities**


**Knowledge Management \& Content Quality**


* Manage the intake, triage, and routing of knowledge\-related requests from operational teams.
* Maintain content lifecycle through SME review checkpoints — flagging material for update, review, or archival on a consistent cadence.
* Identify obsolete, duplicate, or conflicting content and drive resolution through appropriate stakeholders.
* Conduct knowledge audits and implement improvement cycles based on performance data and stakeholder feedback.
* Translate operational knowledge into structured, AI\-ingestible formats ensuring accuracy, consistency, and taxonomy compliance.


**AI Knowledge Readiness \& Technology**


* Structure and groom knowledge content for ingestion into GHX's AI platforms; ensure format, tagging, and taxonomy standards are met.
* Monitor AI platform performance related to knowledge quality; recommend and track content\-driven improvements.
* Partner with data scientists and AI developers to understand ingestion requirements and close content gaps.
* Stay current on trends in AI knowledge management, large language model content requirements, and KM tooling.


**Process Improvement \& Analysis**


* Analyze and document knowledge workflows, identifying gaps or structural issues that reduce content usability or AI accuracy.
* Interpret usage data, feedback trends, and engagement metrics to recommend improvement opportunities.
* Support implementation of governance standards, taxonomy structures, and documentation templates.
* Learn and apply Lean/Six Sigma and knowledge\-centered service (KCS) frameworks where applicable.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Partner with SMEs, operational leaders, and AI teams to promote adoption of AI\-enabled knowledge systems.
* Provide end\-user training and support on knowledge tools, systems, and updated content resources.
* Collect stakeholder requirements and develop content solutions that meet operational team needs.
* Present knowledge health findings and recommendations to leadership with clear next steps.


**Required Skills**


* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor message by audience.
* Familiarity with knowledge management systems (Confluence/Atlassian, Salesforce Knowledge, ServiceNow, or equivalent).
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret usage data and translate findings into action.
* Detail\-oriented with ability to manage multiple knowledge domains and adjust priorities as needed.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, SharePoint, Forms); CRM familiarity a plus (Salesforce preferred).
* Self\-directed learner who identifies gaps and takes initiative to close them.
* Understanding of how content structure and taxonomy affect AI/ML model performance preferred.


**Education \& Experience**


* 2\+ years of related experience in knowledge management, operations enablement, content governance, or business analysis.
* Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining content for both human consumption (training, SOPs) and machine ingestion (AI platforms, knowledge bases).
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Management, Organizational Development, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Change management or KM certification (Prosci, KCS, ACMP) a plus.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
**Job Purpose**
The Business Continuity Operations Analyst is a dual\-function role embedded within daily operations while owning the lifecycle of BC/DR planning, testing, and readiness. You will provide direct support to engineering, IT, and business teams to minimize disruption impact while simultaneously assisting with developing and maintaining the plans, assessments, and exercises that ensure ICE can sustain critical operations through any scenario.  

This is a 24x7 environment; the position may require weekend scheduling and shift flexibility. **Responsibilities** ***Operations \& Incident Management**** Own incidents end\-to\-end: communication, escalation, follow\-up, and root\-cause analysis (RCA) documentation.
* Quickly assess incidents and provide management with well\-conceived short\- and long\-term service restoration actions.
* Work with internal partners to communicate and address concerns across business units.
* Follow organizational practices for Incident Management; maintain accurate records in ServiceNow.

 ***Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery**** Support the creation, documentation, and maintenance of Business Continuity Plans (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies across assigned business segments.
* Assist in conducting Business Impact Analyses (BIA) and risk assessments to identify critical business functions, dependencies, and vulnerabilities.
* Coordinate and participate in regular BC/DR tests, tabletop exercises, and simulation drills; document results and track remediation actions.
* Maintain plan repositories, contact lists, and exercise records; prepare post\-exercise reports and readiness summaries for stakeholders.
* Provide operational support during actual continuity events, including communications, escalation tracking, and incident documentation.

 ***Training, Documentation \& Awareness**** Assist in training employees on emergency response procedures, continuity protocols, and incident escalation paths.
* Prepare and maintain troubleshooting guides, escalation runbooks, and procedural documentation for both operational and BC scenarios.
* Support awareness programs that keep business units informed of their continuity obligations and current plan status.

 **Knowledge and Experience*** Bachelor's degree (or Associate's degree with relevant experience) in Information Technology, Business Continuity, Risk Management, or a related field.
* 2\-4 years of experience in IT operations, systems/application support, business continuity, or risk management.
* Operational Aptitude: Ability to remain organized and decisive under pressure when managing urgent, critical production issues.
* Analytical Thinking: Logical, root\-cause\-oriented approach to both technical troubleshooting and business process risk assessment.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to interface effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders at all levels.
* Reliability: Demonstrates flexibility, attention to detail, and follow\-through on both operational and program responsibilities.
* Team Orientation: Able to work independently and collaboratively; willing to assist outside of defined role boundaries when the situation calls for it

***Preferred**** Experience with financial markets, trading systems, or clearing operations.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow (Incident, Problem, Change, and/or BC modules).
* Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and automation platforms: BigPanda, PagerDuty, Rundeck.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite; experience with continuity management software a plus.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CBCP, ABCP, ITIL Foundation) are a plus but not required.

**This role supports the Marketing Plan to Cash (MP2C) value stream and is aligned with the ASPIRE roadmap, a multi\-year global initiative aiming to define and develop functional ERP roadmaps that simplify, standardize, and automate core business processes leveraging SAP industry best practices. * Complexity / (Product Size): Manage requirements and system interdependencies across complex multi\-solution enterprise landscapes. Oversee and ensure integrations between SAP SD and adjacent applications, including SFDC, SAP Hybris, 3PL/4PL integration solutions.
* Business / Technical Ability: Apply deep domain and technical expertise in SAP SD customizing, configuration, and interface monitoring (iDoc, XML, Web Services, RFC, CIF). * Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent degree

* 4\+ years of hands\-on technical expertise working directly within SAP SD and associated modules (MM/EWM)
* Minimum of 3 full lifecycle SAP implementations from blueprint to go\-live, with at least 1 project delivered in a lead capacity
* Proven track record of independently managing end\-to\-end ERP solution delivery, handling ambiguous requirements, and translating strategic objectives into execution plans


****Technical Skills****
* In\-depth functional knowledge of SAP SD core configuration, master data, pricing, and end\-to\-end Order\-to\-Cash processes (e.g., Sales Order Management, Shipping, Billing, and Credit Management functionalities).
* Thorough understanding of cross\-module dependencies including SAP FI/CO, MM, EWM, PP etc

 At Roche Digital Technology (RDT), we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.

 The Outbound and Flow team within Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) is looking for an experienced Product Manager (Technical) to own the vision and strategy for Routing and Mansort products, based out of Bangalore. Our team provides the products and services responsible for outbound fulfillment — ingesting shipments from upstream systems (SCOT) and processing them through picking, packing, and shipping. Our vision is to improve customer experience — Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), Speed, Quality, and Cost — while improving associate safety and simplifying our operations. We do so by building products that are highly reliable, resilient, self\-healing, scalable, extensible, and designed from the start with a focus on the safety and accessibility of our workforce.
   

  

 As a Product Manager (Technical) — L6 for Routing and Mansort, you will define, execute, and deliver a product roadmap that optimizes how units and packages are routed through the fulfillment center and how manual sortation (Mansort) operations are streamlined for throughput, quality, and cost. You will strongly influence the strategy and vision for the group, and develop and maintain product roadmaps and features grounded in team strategy. This role is inherently cross\-functional — you will work closely with engineering, science, operations, and business teams across geographies to launch features and build the tools and mechanisms that scale Routing and Mansort worldwide.
   

  

 A successful candidate will be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high\-quality, simple products, features, and applications. You will identify opportunities to make FC operations more efficient, and drive the design and development of software features to address them — leveraging and expanding current initiatives in Primitives and GenAI across the organization.

* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities by working backward from customer needs, conducting research, analyzing usage data and market trends, and translating insights into clear problem statements and requirements.
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration with engineering, design, science, finance, and operations partners to deliver products on time and with high quality, aligning stakeholders and making smart trade\-offs when data is incomplete.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle from concept through launch and beyond, including defining success criteria and key performance indicators, monitoring operational health, and iterating based on performance metrics and customer feedback.

* Leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate development cycles, improve decision\-making, and unlock new opportunities for product innovation.


**About The Team**
 AFT owns and operates the AFT Warehouse Management System (WMS) and select hardware — these technologies automate, orchestrate, and direct fulfillment in Amazon Robotics sort and non\-sort buildings, traditional sort and non\-sort buildings, IXDs, Fresh, Pantry, and Quick Deploy sites. jobs.description:
About This Role
**5 to 15 years of experience**  

**Skills: Murex Collateral module, test, test automation, BO, FO, Margin call, Haircut**

### **About the Role**


We are looking for an experienced Murex specialist to join our Collateral Management technology team. This role sits at the intersection of business and technology, translating complex collateral and margining requirements into robust Murex MX.3 solutions. You'll work closely with front office, risk, operations, and IT teams to design, configure, and deliver functionality that keeps our collateral processes efficient, compliant, and future\-ready.


### **What You'll Do**


* Act as the functional lead for Murex MX.3 initiatives, with a primary focus on the Collateral Management module
* Gather and translate business requirements from trading, risk, and operations stakeholders into functional specifications and system configurations
* Support the full delivery lifecycle — from design and build through UAT, regression testing, and go\-live
* Advise on margin and exposure workflows spanning Initial Margin, Variation Margin, CSA/ISDA terms, SIMM calculations, haircuts, and eligibility schedules
* Apply product knowledge across OTC derivatives, FX, Fixed Income, Repo, and Securities Financing Transactions to ensure collateral logic reflects real trading behavior
* Partner with regulatory and compliance teams to keep collateral processes aligned with Uncleared Margin Rules (UMR), BCBS\-IOSCO standards, and Basel III requirements
* Contribute to integrations linking Murex with third\-party margining platforms (e.g., AcadiaSoft, TriResolve), SWIFT messaging, custodian banks, and downstream settlement systems
* Write and troubleshoot SQL queries, shell scripts, and MxML flows to support configuration, data investigation, and issue resolution
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to CI/CD and cloud\-based delivery pipelines where applicable
* Provide production support and root\-cause analysis for collateral and margin\-related incidents

### **What You Bring**


* 8\+ years working as a Business Analyst or Functional Consultant on Murex MX.3, with substantial time spent in Collateral Management


* Solid grasp of margin call processing, exposure calculation, and collateral optimization concepts


* Practical understanding of derivatives and financing products (OTC, FX, Fixed Income, Repo, SFTs) and how they drive collateral requirements


* Comfort working across the delivery lifecycle: requirements definition, system configuration, test planning/execution, and implementation support


* Technical fluency in SQL, Unix/Linux environments, and MxML


* Familiarity with industry margining utilities such as AcadiaSoft or TriResolve


* Working knowledge of regulatory frameworks impacting collateral — UMR, BCBS\-IOSCO, Basel III


* Exposure to Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and cloud infrastructure


* Prior experience connecting Murex to SWIFT networks, custodians, or settlement platforms is a strong plus


* Scripting or development experience in Python or Java is a plus

### **Job Description**


Role: Head – Operations Excellence \& Business Intelligence

  

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

  

Location: Whitefield, Bengaluru \| On\-site / Operations Floor

  

Company Description

  

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS) is a pioneer in teleradiology, delivering round\-the\-clock diagnostic radiology reporting and support to hospitals and healthcare providers across India, the US, and other global markets. Founded in 2002 by two Yale\-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, TRS today serves over 150 hospitals across 21 countries. The company pairs a network of board\-certified radiologists — including ABR\-certified specialists — with technology\-driven workflows and its AI\-enabled arm, dAIgnostiX, to deliver fast, accurate, and reliable imaging interpretation. dAIgnostiX is based out of Bengaluru (Whitefield). TRS/dAIX also maintains an active academic focus (www.radguru.net) and ongoing research interests, including AI in radiology.

  

The Opportunity

  

TRS is scaling rapidly, with an ambition to significantly increase daily reading capacity while maintaining high standards of quality, turnaround time and customer experience.

  

As we scale, we need to move from fragmented, function\-specific ways of managing processes and performance to a common operating system for execution — with clear processes, transparent KPIs, disciplined review rhythms and rapid problem\-solving.

  

We are looking for a young, high\-energy, hands\-on builder to establish and lead this capability.

  

This is not a traditional PMO role focused on project reports, PowerPoint presentations or following up on action trackers. You will work directly with operating teams, spend significant time on the floor, understand how work actually flows, identify bottlenecks, build the tools and processes required to fix them, and personally drive implementation.

  

You will work closely with the COO and operating leaders across Production Operations, ABR Experience and Customer Management.

  

What You Will Own

  

1\. Build the TRS Operations Management System

  

Create a common methodology for managing operational improvement across functions, replacing fragmented trackers and review mechanisms with:

  

* Standard operating and improvement methodology
* Common project and action tracking
* Clearly defined owners, milestones and escalation mechanisms
* Standard daily, weekly and monthly operating reviews
* Consistent problem\-solving using Lean / Six Sigma principles
* Clear visibility of progress, risks, bottlenecks and outcomes
* The expectation is to build and establish the system, not simply recommend it.

  

2\. Build the Operations KPI \& Performance Dashboard

  

Own the design, development and ongoing management of a live operations dashboard covering key dimensions such as:

  

* Productivity and throughput
* RVUs / readings per day and leading indicators
* ABR capacity and utilization
* SLA / turnaround\-time performance
* Customer escalations
* Employee / ABR satisfaction
* Improvement\-project performance

  

The successful candidate should be comfortable going beyond defining dashboard requirements and should be capable of building the first working version personally.

  

3\. Establish Daily Management Discipline

  

Design and run the operating cadence across the key operating functions. This includes:

  

* Daily operational reviews
* Weekly performance and improvement reviews
* Monthly business reviews
* Clear escalation mechanisms
* Action tracking and closure
* Identification of emerging risks before they become operational issues

  

The role is responsible for the quality and effectiveness of these reviews, not simply scheduling meetings and circulating minutes.

  

4\. Own the End\-to\-End Value Stream

  

Develop and continuously improve the end\-to\-end value stream for diagnostic interpretation:

  

Client order Assignment Case loading Reading Proofing Sign\-out Delivery

  

Identify and quantify:

  

* Bottlenecks
* Queues and waiting time
* Capacity constraints
* Rework
* Handover losses
* Routing / assignment inefficiencies
* Root causes of SLA and customer issues

  

You should be able to conduct a Gemba walk, map the process, analyse the data and translate the findings into practical interventions.

  

5\. Turn Pilots into Scaled Operating Practices

  

A key part of the role will be taking successful improvement pilots and converting them into repeatable, scalable operating processes. For example, where a routing or assignment intervention demonstrates measurable improvement at one site or for one workflow, you will:

  

* Understand why it worked
* Standardize the process
* Define the SOP and controls
* Build the tracking mechanism
* Train the teams
* Pilot and measure
* Scale across the organization
* Monitor sustainability

  

You will work directly with the people performing the work — including assigners, case loaders, readers and proofers — rather than managing implementation remotely through presentations.

  

6\. Build the Team and Process Owner Network

  

Build a small, high\-calibre central team covering:

  

* Process excellence / Lean methodology
* Performance management and analytics
* Project execution

  

In parallel, establish a network of embedded process owners / improvement champions across the operating functions. The objective is to create a small, highly capable central hub that enables improvement across the entire organization, rather than a large PMO.

  

7\. Drive Cross\-Functional Execution

 Business Analyst \| CEO’s Office
 



 Location : Bangalore
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We're looking for a
 **Business Analyst** 
 to join the CEO's Office and turn data into decisions. You'll work directly with business leaders across the company on high\-priority problems, dig into the numbers, and deliver insights that shape strategy and growth.
 



 You'll use
 **AI tools** 
 as part of your everyday workflow to analyze faster and automate repetitive work. This role suits someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, moves quickly, and can explain complex findings in plain language.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 


* **Extract and Prepare Data:** 
 Pull, clean, and transform large, often unstructured datasets from our data warehouses into reliable, analysis\-ready form.
* **Partner with the Business:** 
 Work closely with cross\-functional leaders to understand their questions, define data requirements, and build scalable, long\-term reporting solutions.
* **Find the "Why":** 
 Go deep into key metrics to spot trends, patterns, and the root causes of business bottlenecks, and turn them into clear, actionable recommendations.
* **Build Dashboards:** 
 Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards and interactive visualizations that give teams self\-serve access to the data they need.
* **Deliver in a Fast\-Paced Environment:** 
 Manage competing priorities in an Agile setup, take ownership of loosely defined problems, and drive them to clear outcomes with minimal supervision.



  





 What We're Looking For
 



  





 Experience
 


* **2 years** 
 of hands\-on analytics experience in
 **retail, e\-commerce, gift cards, or quick commerce** 
 .



  





 Technical Skills
 



**Must Have** 



* **Advanced SQL** 
 , including writing optimized queries and extracting data from large datasets.
* **Advanced Excel** 
 , including data modeling and macros.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Python for data manipulation and analysis.
* VBA for automation.
* Experience with Google BigQuery.
* Hands\-on use of AI tools for analysis, automation, or building workflows.



  





 Core Competencies
 


* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of presenting data\-driven findings clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Comfort working on CEO\-level priorities, with sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Strong adaptability and a proven ability to handle ambiguity while managing multiple critical projects and deadlines at once.

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Credit Risk
jobs.description:
**Project Description:** 




 The Business Analyst will work with Moody's Credit Risk team of UK Based Investement Bank and work collaboratively with Country Finance, Treasury, Group Liquidity Regulatory reporting and BAU teams to understand requirements and articulate them within the Business and data requirements document
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* To act as a business solution owner of the projects' target state and support analysis included in relevant concept and methodology papers required for preparation of BRDs
* To be accountable for ensuring that detailed requirements are documented in BRDs, and are duly signed off by relevant stakeholders
* To ensure that the new solutions comply with internal procedures / external regulatory guidelines and project deliverables are properly understood by business stakeholders, project team, and end\-users.
* Analysis of new data sourcing to support ETL design and development
* Elicitation of data requirements and documentation of data mapping specifications for Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) computation
* Analysis and fixing of data quality issues
* Validate all downstream data extracts
* To validate that the strategic system architecture proposed by Technology is fit for its business purpose and is in line with the agreed business target state
* To drive prioritization taking into consideration business benefits, delivery timelines, system performance etc.
* To centrally coordinate system interfaces/dependencies/change releases for the Treasury and Liquidity Reporting work streams and ensure alignment across all centres
* Test planning, coordinate testing, validate test results and obtain sign off from stakeholders
* To support the development of testing packs with predefined results sets
* To review test cases ensuring completeness of UAT coverage
* To monitor any gaps / defects identified, and work with Technology counterparts to track progress and ensure resolution



  





**Mandatory Skills Description:** 



* 5 to 12 years of functional experience in Credit Risk, Capital risk, regulatory reporting change Management roles
* Good understanding of financial \& capital markets domain with sound knowledge of products like equities, fixed income, derivatives, forex etc.
* Good exp. in BCBS 239 or Basel evolution, Data lineage constraints , Liquidity ratios, PD, LGD, EAD or RWA calculations.
* Knowledge of Basel Capital regulations and good understanding of financial risk
* Expertise in SQL and Oracle tools.
* Experience with both waterfall \& agile methodologies
* Experience in analysing data to draw business\-relevant conclusions and in data visualization techniques and tools
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills Description:** 



* Moody's experience , FRM Certification

**Job Title:**

 : CEFS\-Reconciliation
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 The IT Reconciliations Department is managing the reconciliations (Financial, Referential, Systems to Systems, ...) for a number of BNP Paribas's domains (Global Markets, Global Banking, Security Services, Wealth Management, ...) via specialized expert systems (FIS DIM/Intellimatch, Pega PCM, Socrates).

These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis \& Project Management, Development \& Maintenance and Quality Control. jobs.title: Business Analyst I
jobs.description:
**Overview**
 A s a Business Analyst, this position drives client onboarding success, optimizes operational processes, and translates business requirements into scalable products and automation solutions. The role serves as a bridge between clients, internal stakeholders, and technical teams to support solution delivery, data\-driven decision\-making, and continuous process improvement. It aligns with Business Analyst responsibilities and includes advanced exposure to analytical, reporting, and process optimization work.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Act as the primary point of contact for new and existing clients during onboarding and post\-implementation phases.
* Own the end\-to\-end implementation journey for standard and high\-priority enterprise clients, ensuring smooth adoption and adherence to defined onboarding milestones.
* Manage complex client engagements involving multiple stakeholders, systems, and dependencies.
* Gather, analyze, and document client requirements, operational gaps, and business needs.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and operations teams to design and deliver scalable solutions aligned with client and business objectives .
* Draft and finalize functional and business specifications, securing stakeholder approval before development begins.
* Collect, analyze, and interpret client and operational data to identify risks, trends, and improvement opportunities.
* Prepare structured reports and communicate insights to internal and external stakeholders.
* Drive process improvement and automation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and streamline workflows.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams during development, testing, deployment, and post\-deployment validation while maintaining complete implementation documentation.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration , Information Systems, Computer Science, Operations, or a related field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* 3\+ years of experience in business analysis, client onboarding, implementation, operations, process improvement, or a related client\-facing role.
* Experience translating client or stakeholder needs into business requirements, functional specifications, and delivery documentation.
* Experience working with product, engineering, operations, support, or other cross\-functional teams to deliver business solutions.
* Working knowledge of reporting, data analysis, user acceptance testing, and process documentation.
* Travel requirement: minimal, as business needs require.


**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**
**Required:**
* Client onboarding, relationship management, and stakeholder communication.
* Business and solution analysis, requirements gathering, and functional specification writing.
* Data interpretation, reporting, insight development, and data\-driven recommendation skills.
* Process mapping, operational improvement, and automation\-focused problem solving.
* Cross\-functional coordination across product, engineering, operations, support, and client teams.
* Testing coordination, quality validation, documentation discipline, and change\-request tracking.
* Strong organization, prioritization, issue resolution, and follow\-through in complex client engagements.

 While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger
